Comment.value: Divine Champion initiation reagent (roadmap: divine-champion-quest). Kindled at the Altar of the Istari in the Minas Tirith temple (q_dvc_altar OnUsed, instance tag DvcVigilAltar) only when the vigil-keeping PC bears a shield on the off-hand arm (QDVC_IsShieldBorne in q_dvc_inc -- GetItemInSlot(INVENTORY_SLOT_LEFTHAND) is a small/large/tower shield, base items 14/56/57 verified in ovr/nwscript.nss). GetItemPossessedBy check at Halmir's turn-in (q_dvc_c_rdy). Plot + cursed so it cannot be sold, dropped or traded; q_dvc_finish clears the plot flag and consumes it. BaseItem 24 + ModelPart1 44 copied from the module's existing Notch of the Proven Blade (q_wpm_notch).

value.0: A small flame that weighs nothing and does not gutter, kindled from the polished stone of the Altar of the Istari in the temple of Minas Tirith. It gives no heat, casts no shadow, and cannot be set down -- the altar lends its light only to a hand that came bearing a shield, and takes it back from any hand that tries to spend it. The chaplains call it an oath-light: proof that a vigil was kept as the order keeps it, standing between, and it means nothing to anyone but Halmir the Grey, who keeps the Champions' page by candlelight.
